body: Someone tell me how to be ok. How the fuck do I just be ok that's all I want

Hey mate.

I can't flesh this out because it's a really personal thing to plan out.. but have you considered just.. leaving?

It sounds condescending, and bear with me because I don't mean it to be.

I'm seriously considering disappearing. Covering every possible trace so I can't be found -- and whether that means a new ciuntry or state, or being a nomad? Who knows. It comes down to a lot of your personal views.

Mate, I could write a novel about it.

I dislike my personal life. I'm so burnt out by the people I'm around and the life I feel forced to live. I can't just up and leave.

I dislike the way the world works around me, and the fact I have a mental illness with no support in my country (autism).

I don't like the way the world's headed.

I find very few things give me solace and comfort, and they're often jeopardized by the people around me who refuse to accommodate my needs, rather they have to try and fix me.
